Calculator, Currencies, Units, and Time Zones
The result appears in gray after \"=\". Space inserts it, and Backspace right after the insertion undoes it.
Auto picks the default currency by your phone number.

Functions and constants. Separate arguments with \";\" or a comma followed by a space.
bin, oct and hex show a number in another base, and dec(x, n) reads x in base n.
A percentage after + or − is taken from the number on its left.
\"k\" means a thousand and \"kk\" a million. \"thousand\" and \"million\" work too.
Without \"to\" or \"in\", an amount converts to the default currency.
Without \"to\" or \"in\", foreign units convert to your measurement system, and your own ones to a handier unit.
Durations are split into days, hours and minutes.
A time in another zone converts to yours.
Add \"in\" and a city to convert there. \"now\" shows the current time.
